newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Three Russian journalists kidnapped in Chechnya.
newsitem.headline: Three Russian journalists kidnapped in Chechnya.

text.p: Three Russian journalists have been kidnapped by armed men in Russia's rebel region of Chechnya, Russian Television said on Wednesday.
A Russian Television correspondent in Chechnya said a journalist from the Itar-Tass news agency and two Radio Russia reporters were kidnapped on Tuesday evening.
Their car was stopped by armed men, they were transferred to another car, and were driven away.
Both Tass and Radio Russia were unable to give any details immediately, saying only that they were looking into the incident.

Kidnapping, usually for a ransom, is widespread in the mountainous region where nearly all men are armed and which was largely destroyed after a 21-month conflict between Russian troops and rebels which ended last August.
Last month an Italian photographer was kidnapped under similar circumstances. His fate remains unknown.
Two journalists working for Public Russian Television were freed last month after being held captive for one month.
